text: Thanks; use actual baseline batch=8 and concurrency=16. Estimated reductions are not acceptance evidence. For each phase run the same signed workload_hash and seed, then report p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, energy/token, timeout, exact-match or task score, and confidence intervals. Reject a phase if p95 improves but correctness drops over 1% or p99 regresses. Use closed-loop for service SLO and open-loop for the saturation curve.
